author: codex-root

findings.summary: The loopback hostname policy is duplicated between origin validation and the parent-host capability check.
findings.consequence: If one allowlist changes without the other, local HTTP embed behavior can become inconsistent: the parent may grant the capability while the origin validator rejects it, or the reverse.
findings.evidence: `svenskaReaderEmbedOrigin` gates local HTTP origins through `localHosts.has(url.hostname)` here, while `useReaderDictionaryEmbed.ts` has a separate `localParentHosts` set for the same localhost, 127.0.0.1, and [::1] policy before passing `allowLocalHttp`.
findings.recommendation: Move the loopback hostname predicate to one shared helper used by both the parent-host check and this origin validator, keeping the explicit `allowLocalHttp` option as the capability boundary.
